meta.expect: One cold line each (his home is not on the table), back to the essay; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen's zero went into the gradebook and he found out on his phone, in class. Who decided that, and before or after anyone spoke to him?
Before we start, is everything okay at home? I heard his dad moved out in the spring.
His home is not on the table, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone call me first?
He's been falling asleep in class. I'm genuinely worried about him.
If you were worried, Hale, you had my number. Procedure 4.2 says you call the parent before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Who decided on the zero?
He told me he works twenty hours a week at the grocery store. That's a lot.
Owen's job is not why we're here. You gave him a zero, and I'm still waiting to hear what it rests on. What do you have on the essay?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record; that is not the fair outcome, since a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 was never reached, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you put no evidence about the essay in front of her.
What cost ground: You spent your turns asking about his home life, his sleep and his job, which she treated as a way around the zero and which gave her nothing to check.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never got near that night, since you only raised his tiredness and his hours at work, with no dates or times; it proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open with one sentence owning that the zero went in before you called her, which procedure 4.2 required, then put a dated document about the essay in front of her.
